description: Procurement of Gasoline, Murban Crude Oil and Gas oil
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation has invited bids from the registered suppliers of the said Corporation for the purchase of Gasoline 92 Unl, Murban Crude Oil and Gas Oil (0.05% M.S.) under term contracts, following the limited international competitive procurement procedure. The proposals made by the Minister of Energy to award the said procurements to the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidders as follows, based on the recommendations made by the Standing High Level Procurement Committees after evaluating the bids submitted accordingly, was approved by the Cabinet: Petroleum Production and quantityNo of bids receivedRecommended bidderContract Period011.2 million Bbls ±5% of Gasoline 92 Unl4M/s.
